name: Clarissa Mayer
original_name: クラリッサ・マイアー
source:
Clarissa serves as [url=/c123909]Arnold[/url]'s family doctor and as his private tutor. She is an intelligent and caring woman with a doting older sister temperament. She can speak three languages - German, English and Japanese. 
Clarissa is [url=/c123918]Vincent[/url]'s niece, which makes her somewhat familiar with the occult, but she isn't a believer in it.  She teaches Arnold to play the piano. She suffers from lightheadedness in the morning due to her low blood pressure.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A5%88%E8%90%BD%E3%81%AE%E5%9F%8E_%E4%B8%80%E6%9F%B3%E5%92%8C%E3%80%812%E5%BA%A6%E7%9B%AE%E3%81%AE%E5%8F%97%E9%9B%A3]Wikipedia[/url].]
